name: com.dveracity/semantic-mcp
title: dVeracity Semantic API
description: Natural-language queries over a verified emissions knowledge graph, plus standards validation

environmentVariables.name: DVERACITY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: dVeracity API key (dvrc_...). Required for the stdio package; metered calls are billed to it. Not used by the remote endpoint, which authenticates with OAuth.

environmentVariables.name: DVERACITY_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Override the API base URL; defaults to production.

environmentVariables.name: DVERACITY_KERI_AID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Agent AID enabling vLEI-verified identity mode.

environmentVariables.name: DVERACITY_KERI_PRESENTATION
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to the CESR presentation used with the agent AID.
